name: Taste Rite Jamaican Bakery
location_note: One location of a small ~6-7 location South Florida chain. This demo is built specifically for the Pembroke Pines location, using its own real address and phone.

hours.source: Cross-checked from two independent aggregators (Yahoo Local business listing and RestaurantGuru summary), both stating Mon-Sat 9:30am-6:00pm, closed Sundays. A third source (zmenu snippet, 'open today 11am-10pm') conflicted and was treated as unreliable/likely-default placeholder data, so it was discarded in favor of the two agreeing sources. Not independently confirmed against Google's own listing HTML.

rating_source: RestaurantGuru aggregate page explicitly states 'Google: 4.5/5 (484 reviews)', matching the rating/count given at task start.

instagram.external_url: YouTube link only, no proprietary domain

has_own_site_verification: tasteritebakery.com resolves (HTTP 200) but is a GoDaddy/wsimg domain-parking lander page (window.onload redirect to /lander, page served by img1.wsimg.com 'parking-lander' bundle) - NOT an owned business site. tasteritejamaicanbakery.com does not resolve. tasterite.com is an unrelated redirect. No proprietary domain found in IG bio, Facebook About, or any aggregator profile. Only directory/aggregator pages exist (Yelp, RestaurantGuru, Restaurantji, Wheree, Zmenu, Postmates, Yahoo Local, cafecityguide mirrors for sister locations). CONFIRMED has_own_site: false.

menu.note: Only real, cross-checked items are priced. Items found only in a single less-reliable source (or where sources disagreed on price) are listed by name only, per instruction not to invent prices.

menu.postmates_price_note: A Postmates delivery menu was found with much higher prices (e.g. Beef Patty $3.90, Chicken $4.29) than the two in-store aggregator sources ($1.90/$2.00). This is consistent with typical delivery-platform markup. The lower, cross-checked in-store price set was used for priced items; the higher delivery prices were not used anywhere.

reviews_found.author: Maurice R.
reviews_found.date: 2026-05-30 (approx, '4 months ago' at time of research)
reviews_found.text: I stumbled upon this gem of a spot that has some amazing Jamaican patties. They have a jerk chicken which I never seen before, they are delicious.
reviews_found.source: Yahoo Local business listing (mirrors Google reviews)

reviews_found.author: Nathan D.
reviews_found.date: 2025-10-14 (approx, '5 months ago' at time of research)
reviews_found.text: Imo best jamaican patties in south florida. I've been to the sunrise location and this one is just as good.
reviews_found.source: Yahoo Local business listing (mirrors Google reviews)

reviews_found.author: Suzanne G.
reviews_found.text: Hands down, the BEST patties in all of South Florida!!! Lots of variety too. Beef, jerk chicken, fish, ackee & saltfish, to name a few.
reviews_found.source: Yahoo Local business listing (mirrors Google reviews)

reviews_found.author: Sharhonte W.
reviews_found.text: I have gone to this place many times, it doesn't matter which location you go to the patties are always fresh and nice!
reviews_found.source: Yahoo Local business listing (mirrors Google reviews)

reviews_found.author: Lolita M.
reviews_found.date: 5 months ago at time of research
reviews_found.text: Got the cheesy beef, jerk chicken and callalo patty with coco bread. Hands down, the callalo was insanely delicious.

reviews_found.author: John Tone
reviews_found.date: 5 months ago at time of research
reviews_found.text: I ordered four different patties and all were delicious and freshly made. First time trying callaloo, delicious because I love vegetables.

brand_colors_source: Cropped directly from a real Taste Rite Jamaican Bakery Instagram post (Hurricane Melissa relief flyer graphic, bk-4.jpg raw asset): golden-yellow background, warm gold circular badge/medallion with red script wordmark 'Taste Rite' and green leaf accents. Palette derived: warm golden-wheat/mustard gold (accent-deep #b8860a, accent-mid #d1a237) on cream bakery-bread background (#faf6ec), with coffee-brown dark sections (#2b2013 / #19130b) for CTA and footer bands. Distinct from all previously used repo palettes (coral fairy, caramelo, esmeralda, teal acero, violeta dark, tangerine).

photos.source: scripts/ig_photos.py against @tasteritebakery public IG feed (via ig-photo-service Railway proxy), 12 posts scanned, 12 valid photos downloaded to assets/raw/
photos.curation: 8 of 12 raw photos used (bk-1, bk-3, bk-6, bk-7, bk-8, bk-9, bk-10, bk-11). Excluded bk-2, bk-4, bk-5, bk-12 because they are graphics/screenshots with text overlays (a press-mention screenshot, an 'OPEN' promo graphic, a Hurricane Melissa relief flyer, and a second press screenshot) rather than real product/interior photos, per DESIGN.md photo curation rules.
photos.logo: assets/logo.jpg is a tight crop of the real circular badge/medallion from the Hurricane Melissa relief flyer (bk-4.jpg), which is the clearest visible rendering of the actual Taste Rite logo mark found in the available real photos. No clean standalone logo/profile photo was available from the feed.

template_base: templates/light-v2/index.html (Lash Bloom exemplar structure), derived via scripts/build_tasteritejamaicanbakerypembrokepines.py
niche_adaptation_notes: Bakery, not a reservable service business. 'Servicios' section became 'Menu' with real bakery items. 'El Método' 4-step section became 'Fresh Every Day' describing the real baking/hand-folding/walk-in process (dough made fresh, hand-folded patties, baked golden, walk in no wait) instead of a fictional appointment ritual. All booking/Booksy CTAs replaced with tel: (Call to Order) and Google Maps directions links, no booking platform exists for this business. JSON-LD type is Bakery.
